notes.title: Hero Academy 2 updated!
notes.content:
Changes and improvements: 
[list]
[*]  All Crystal Shards count towards your Duel Chests. No more lost leftovers!
[*] Global Chat re-enabled for PC/Mac.
[*] New FX when a hero gets executed.
[*] More keyboard support.
[*] Updated card filtering to show how many cards qualify for a filter before applying.
[*] Bug Fixes.
[/list]

Balance changes:

We wanted to build on the good things from the last balance update and continue bringing some of the underutilized cards into play more often. That has a nice side effect of adding more strategies for the various houses. We don't feel like there are enough animals in play, yet. 
So, we've adjusted their stats along with a few other underused cards. Glade Sentinel and Royal Attendant were also need a bit of a boost. We have adjusted them to make them more viable for more Warden decks. We've reduced the cost on a few spells to also get them more play time and increase the opportunities for synergy.

Made animals better
[list]
[*] Skall - 2/5 (was 1/5)
[*] Bengalus - 2/4/1 (was 2/2/1)
[*] Pounce - down to 1 cost (from 2)
[/list]
Boost up some underused cards
[list]
[*] Phantom Echo - down to 1 cost (from 2)
[*] Inhellation - down to 1 cost (from 2)
[*] Royal Attendant - down to 3 cost (from 4)
[*] Get Hyped - down to 1 cost (from 2)
[*] Glade Sentinel - 3/3, up to 4 mana cost (was 3/2 for 3)
[*] Wickedpedia - 4/4 (was 3/3)
[*] Skall - 2/5 (was 1/5)
[*] Bengalus - 2/4/1 (was 2/2/1)
[*] Alchemist Toxx - 1/4 (was 1/3)
[/list]
